video_title: Mitchell Robinson Exit Interview: Talks Knicks Championship, Jalen Brunson & Leaving For Boston

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the importance of offensive rebounds in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I don't think people understand how important offensive rebounds are.
quotes.quote: It was just crazy that my last rebound in New York was an offensive rebound. I've been doing that the whole year, and for that to come there and help seal this game, I don't think people understand how important offensive rebounds are.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the Knicks' growth and playoff progression
quotes.excerpt: You can see the progress and that's one of those true sayings, trust the progress.
quotes.quote: Being in New York, especially for eight years, you know, we weren't winning many games in my early career. We got to the first round, lost. Second round, lost. Then we got to the Eastern Conference Finals last season, and to be able to get it all done this year, it's just like you can see the progress and that's one of those true sayings, trust the progress.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Jalen Brunson's leadership during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: When he stepped up and did that, it woke us up. We needed that.
quotes.quote: When Jalen Brunson stepped up and did that, it woke us up. We needed that. I wish we could have gotten it a little earlier, but we needed that. After that moment, it was just like, all right, here we go, let's get this.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on his chemistry with Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I love doing what he can get a pocket three. I set that screen up there real high.
quotes.quote: Every time, I love doing what he can get a pocket three. I set that screen up there real high so he can come off and shoot it because they know I'm going to roll to the basket. The big is always back, they're rarely up. I get so much confidence every time he shoots it. It's like I'm up there holding the three like I just shot it.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on his role as a defensive communicator
quotes.excerpt: I really just brought up my communication. I've had three coaches, we've changed up so much stuff.
quotes.quote: I really just brought up my communication. I've had three coaches, we've changed up so much stuff. When we played Philly, it was more like, okay, I know how to guard this guy and I had so much success with it three years ago, two years ago, whatever it was. Let me stick to doing that part. I can maintain a little bit more, and they trust me on that end.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on defending Joel Embiid and staying out of foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: When I'm guarding Joel Embiid, my best thing is to try to stay out of foul trouble.
quotes.quote: When I'm guarding Joel Embiid, my best thing is to try to stay out of foul trouble. That's what I need to do the most, just stay out of foul trouble, really for everybody, but mainly him. Jared Allen, he's a rim threat. He's actually getting a little more comfortable with his little floaters and stuff like that, so I kind of got to pay attention to that stuff too, contest the best way I can.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the difference in playing back-to-back games in Boston
quotes.excerpt: It ain't going to be the same in Boston. I won't be able to play back-to-backs.
quotes.quote: It ain't going to be the same in Boston. I won't be able to play back-to-backs and stuff like that. So, I'm very excited for that, you know. It's been a long time coming, and now I can go out there and play basketball. I don't have to worry about not playing this game, not playing that, whatever, and I can just go out there with a free mind and just hoop.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on his departure from the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I love New York. I fell in love with it once the time went on.
quotes.quote: I love New York. I fell in love with it once the time went on, got used to it, and stuff like that. It is what it is. This is a business at the end of the day, and sometimes things just come to an end. Unfortunately, this is one of those things. But I love New York, I fell in love with it.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Mike Brown's message to the team
quotes.excerpt: He was just telling us, just giving us confidence and stuff like that.
quotes.quote: He was just telling us, just giving us confidence and stuff like that. We had a chance to make history and that was our thing. We wanted to, so once he came in there talking to us, we were on the court when he was talking. He basically was pointing at people and like, hey, when it's time to do what you guys are going to do, you guys are going to be up on screens and stuff like that.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the defensive differences between Tom Thibodeau and Mike Brown
quotes.excerpt: The way that Mike Brown do his defensive scheme and how Tom Thibodeau do his, it was very different.
quotes.quote: The way that Mike Brown do his defensive scheme and how Tom Thibodeau do his, it was very different. But I mean, it worked out for both. I felt like, I mean, obviously we did fall short the year before, so, but overall, it was just different in a lot of ways like the offensive schemes and stuff like that and the way that they wanted us to guard the ball and how to guard off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on playing alongside Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns, he's a great guy. Even if I'm in foul trouble, he's in foul trouble.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns, he's a great guy. Even if I'm in foul trouble, he's in foul trouble, we both will be talking, we're like, man, we got to stop all the damn fouling, dog. Our team needs us, and I damn sure need that because my conditioning wasn't the best.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Mo Bamba's potential
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say Mo Bamba. He's young, long arm, can move his feet and he can shoot it.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Mo Bamba. He's young, long arm, can move his feet and he can shoot it too. He ain't going to shoot it well every night, but most times he was shooting it pretty decent. It's just like how he is on defense, nobody can really get around him. He remind me very much of Frank Ntilikina when we had long arms, sitting down, moving his feet, it's very similar in that aspect.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Jayson Tatum and Derrick White's shooting
quotes.excerpt: Now Jayson Tatum is going to get these pocket threes. Derrick White is going to get some.
quotes.quote: Now Jayson Tatum is going to get these pocket threes. Derrick White is going to get some, Payton Pritchard, you know, it's, it's, it's, you know, and you know, Boston always had like, especially in the regular season, they used to, you know, be a problem for us.
